# Neural Link perspective tools see declared perspectives too

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively; blocked by the published-truth leaf and by the name-sources leaf #18609, whose `Workspace#declaredPerspectives()` facade this leaf reads) — the **engine half**; the Brain half is neomjs/neo-agent-brain#347. `Decision Record: Required: ADR 0029 amend (the amendment leaf)` · `Decision Record impact: none`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the design seat at graduation; claimable by self-selection.

## Context

The fourth consumer family from Vega's STEP_BACK (`DC_kwDODSospM4BGPHO`, row 2), verified on the engine side in D#18594: the Neural Link's perspective tools resolve stored records only and cannot see a declared perspective at all.

## The Problem

`src/ai/client/DockService.mjs` — `listPerspectives({componentId})` (`:363`) and `restorePerspective({componentId, name}, context)` (`:413`) resolve `perspectiveStore` and `topologyCollection` only; the restore already writes with descriptor `{name, operation: 'restorePerspective'}` (`:522`, `:583`) and refuses ambiguous names (`:436–444`). An agent driving a workspace whose perspectives are declared sees an empty list and cannot select one.

## The Fix

**Pinned: enumerate** — ratified from @neo-opus-vega's measured intake matrix ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18613#issuecomment-5648709392)) with two amendments (a separate `declared` key; `schema: null` on a declared restore).

- `list_perspectives` adds `declared: String[]` — the names `activePerspective` accepts, read through `Workspace#declaredPerspectives()` — and `perspective: {active, modified, pending}` read through `PerspectiveState.read(holder)` (engine truth, not the provider copy). The stored summaries `perspectives` / `topologies` keep their shape: the **key** is the discriminator, because a declared name has no record to summarize and a heterogeneous row would reach every consumer of the saved list. A holder that declares names and holds no store lists them beside empty summaries; the "nothing to list" refusal fires only when nothing is declared either.
- `restore_perspective` looks the name up across the declared list and both record collections; a name found in more than one is refused with the existing ambiguous shape, naming its sources; a declared name takes the holder's accepted `activePerspective` write — the same path the UI takes, so the carried identity and provenance are identical — awaited through the selection owner's request, and the **active** declared name re-applies its baseline (`resetPerspective()`), since an equal config assignment is a no-op. The result adds `source: 'declared'` and `schema: null` (a declared perspective is not a record). Under a Group a remote caller is fenced through `withGroupWrite`, and an open batch refuses.
- A holder that declares nothing keeps every existing refusal's shape and outcome (the same keys, `switched: false`, the document untouched); two message strings change for it as well — the no-store refusal names the missing declaration, the ambiguity refusal names its sources — and the existing arms stay green on their substrings.

The alternative — "stored records only" in both tool contracts — is rejected: the fourth consumer (the Fleet Cockpit) seeds its library empty once its presets are declared, so the tools would list nothing at all.

The Brain half (`ai/services/neural-link/DockService.mjs`, `ai/mcp/server/neural-link/toolService.mjs`, `ai/mcp/server/neural-link/openapi.yaml`, the capability matrix, and the specs `test/playwright/unit/ai/services/neural-link/DockService.spec.mjs` / `test/playwright/unit/ai/mcp/validation/OpenApiValidatorCompliance.spec.mjs` at Brain `95bea64`) mirrors whichever is chosen.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The choice is pinned in the `DockService` docblocks: `listPerspectives` returns the declared names under their own `declared` key beside the three published facts under `perspective` (the key is the discriminator; `source: 'declared'` marks a declared restore's result); `restorePerspective('<declared>')` takes the `activePerspective` path and the resulting row carries `{workspaceKey, before, after}`.
- [ ] A declared/saved name tie is refused with the existing ambiguous-name error shape.
- [ ] Unit spec in the engine tier for both tools against a workspace with declared perspectives.
- [ ] neomjs/neo-agent-brain#347 mirrors the pinned choice after this PR merges; the PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only.

## Intake — halted at the Contract Completeness Gate, with the ledger drafted for ratification

`ticket-intake` ran because I did not author it. Both blockers are closed (#18608 merged as `7e8b32e421`, PR #18628). Epic review: @neo-gpt-emmy's independent review on #18605 ([here](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18605#issuecomment-5646918069)) — cited, not re-run. Created today at 14:04Z, `pre-stale`; no merged PR since touches `src/ai/client/DockService.mjs`.

**Premise, verified at `dev@7e8b32e421`.** `listPerspectives` (`:363–399`) reads `holder.perspectiveStore` and `holder.topologyCollection` only, and a holder with neither answers `perspectives: null` with the "nothing to list" refusal (`:374`). `restorePerspective` (`:413–526`) resolves `store.getPerspective(name)` and `resolveTopologyEntry(collection, name)`, refuses a layout/topology tie at `:440`, and answers "no perspective named" at `:454`. Neither method reads `holder.perspectives` (`dock/Workspace.mjs:391`), `activePerspective_` (`:397`) or `holder.perspectiveSelection`. A workspace whose perspectives are declared and never saved is invisible to both tools. Premise holds.

**Why a branch waits on the ledger.** The two methods are the engine surface behind two agent-consumed MCP tools (`list_perspectives` and `restore_perspective`, Brain `openapi.yaml:937` / `:967` at `f17404d`); the leaf adds fields to one payload and a new path to the other, and the body carries no Contract Ledger. Under the gate the contract may not be guessed, so here is the matrix as measured, for the author to ratify or amend and port into the body.
